name: Valpolicella Ripasso

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.
Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.
Indicazione Geografica Tipica, Italy's broad regional tier.
An aged Italian wine. Chianti Riserva needs at least 6 months in barrel and 3 more in bottle before release.
Valpolicella Superiore made with the partly dried skins left over from Amarone or Recioto.

notes: Ripasso is Valpolicella steeped on the skins and seeds left over from recioto and Amarone.
This gives it more alcohol, body, tannin, color and flavor than basic Valpolicella.

blurb.text: A Veneto red DOC made only in Valpolicella, mainly from Corvina and/or Corvinone with Rondinella. The wine is refermented on the pressed skins left after making Amarone or Recioto della Valpolicella.
